title: ICS 234 Work Analysis Matrix
description: Planning worksheet laid out like the Coast Guard ICS 234-CG: each objective from the ICS 202 (desired outcome) with the strategies that could meet it (how) and the tactics or work assignments that carry them out (who, what, where, when). Prepared by the Operations Section Chief before the tactics meeting. Up to 8 rows fit on the page.

marking.description: Exercise marking line shown above and below the form (defaults to EXERCISE · EXERCISE · EXERCISE)

rows.description: One row per tactic or work assignment; repeat the objective and strategy when several tactics serve them

objective.description: Block 4. Objective: the desired outcome, with its ICS 202 letter
examples: A. Protect the raw water intake before 2310

strategy.description: Block 5. Strategy: how the objective is met
examples: Keep oil out of the intake channel

assignment.description: Block 6. Tactic or work assignment (what and where)
examples: Install exclusion boom across the intake channel

resources.description: Resources for the assignment (part of block 6)

responsible.description: Who carries it out (part of block 6)

complete.description: When it is complete, or ongoing (part of block 6)

preparedBy.description: 7. Prepared by (Operations Section Chief), date and time
